label: Mill criticized deontological categorical imperatives, asserting morality must weigh consequences
description: John Stuart Mill formulated a fundamental critique of "The Categorical Imperative", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The Categorical Imperative".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.

label: Rawls formulated the Veil of Ignorance as a procedural Kantian constructivist ethic
description: John Rawls took up the concept of "The Categorical Imperative" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The Categorical Imperative".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

label: The categorical imperative purged of pathological inclinations is radicalized into psychoanalytic fidelity to the drive
description: The concept of "The Categorical Imperative" provided the logical and dialectical basis for the emergence of "Ethics of the Real".
dialecticalTension: Conceptual evolution from "The Categorical Imperative" to "Ethics of the Real".
